schema_source.ddl_verbatim:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS AppGames_Staging (
      staging_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
      run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      source TEXT NOT NULL,
      fetched_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
      game_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      publisher TEXT,
      original_game_release_date TEXT,
      confidence_score REAL NOT NULL CHECK (confidence_score >= 0 AND confidence_score <= 1),
      steam_app_id TEXT,
      studio TEXT,
      tags TEXT,
      source_citation TEXT,
      UNIQUE(run_id, game_id)
    )
mapping_rules: SQLite TEXT and DATETIME -> STRING; REAL -> NUMBER; INTEGER -> INTEGER
NOT NULL -> non-nullable; otherwise nullable: true
every model column is listed in required, so a nullable field must be present as an explicit null rather than omitted
CHECK (col >= a AND col <= b) -> minimum a / maximum b; any other CHECK is recorded as unmapped, not approximated
pipeline-filled columns excluded: staging_id, run_id, model_id, source, fetched_at, game_id

cost.formula: ((prompt - cached + toolUsePrompt) * input + cached * cached_input + (candidates + thoughts) * output) / 1e6
assumptions: toolUsePromptTokenCount billed at the input rate (the page has no separate tool line)
thoughtsTokenCount billed as output, per the page's 'response and reasoning' wording
